author: Unity
description:
The free Internet of Things (IoT) sample project lets you experiment with visualizing real-time sensor data. It includes a virtual office with simulated sensors for occupancy, temperature, humidity, air quality, and light levels.

Use the sample to learn how real-world data drives real-time 3D visualizations.

🔗 Find more free Unity Learn resources: https://on.unity.com/Learn

title: Visualize real-time sensor data
